package.limits: Focused regression and package validation; not current full-suite/live/physical-platform or complete Photoshop parity evidence.

api.state: Each layer exposes artboard metadata; document exposes logical origin, availability and names/guides visibility. UI visibility toggles have no document mutation; their API impact is exposed state.

adobe_api.engine: Same native ArtboardCommand and compositing; existing authenticated job/asset lifecycle, limits and output transport.

menus.tool: Artboard in Move/V group; Shift-V cycles existing factory group.

limitations: Frames, shape/type frames and replaceable frame contents are the next major work; L07 remains open.
Editable PSD/PSB artboard import/export is not implemented. Native27 retains editability; PNG/JPEG/TIFF/PDF render artboards. Existing unsupported PSD artd input is rejected explicitly.

Adobe create-artboard is a bounded URL-input, PNG/JPEG/TIFF/JSON-output subset: sources render to independent raster children, default spacing50 or0–32768; cloud/embedded storage, PSD/PSDC, output scaling/scan and richer manifest fidelity are unsupported.

Native tool has create/move/corner resize, properties, presets, backgrounds, local guides, duplication and fit. Auto-nesting/drop rules, adjacent plus buttons, rich Properties panel/New Document integration and full shortcut/preferences/visual fidelity remain open.
API:4,194,304 canvas pixels,64 layers,128MiB document/exports. Native canvas uses existing36MP/32768-edge limits. Expansion does not auto-shrink the allocated canvas.

General rotated/scaled layer geometry with artboards remains constrained to supported axis-aligned whole-document operations. More crop/resize contexts and logical-origin rotation fidelity need qualification.
New artboard operations currently record explicit unsupported Actions markers; complete recording coverage remains open.

Live Photoshop/UI comparison, independent Adobe output/manifest equivalence, physical Intel/macOS14/26 qualification and exact pixel parity are unqualified. Last desktop evidence remains locked; no re-probe or bypass was attempted.

Per-artboard folder export preserves completed outputs if a later output fails; it refuses existing names and requires atomic hard-link publication. Native PDF is rendered multipage output, not editable vector/text PDF.

Minor UI follow-up: Artboard from Group currently retains the source group name even if the conversion-sheet name field is edited; rename the created board through Layers. This does not block creation/conversion and is deferred under major-functions-first scheduling.
